metric_definitions.top_level: Unique explicit subject routes after alias normalization, excluding self-links and duplicate targets. Direct parent/child routes remain; legacy lateral_* names are retained for comparison with earlier reports.
metric_definitions.strict_lateral: Explicit routes excluding declared direct parents and direct children. Neither graph includes automatic child routes added by core.connect.
metric_definitions.thin_leaf: No declared children and no outgoing route in the measured graph.
metric_definitions.hygiene_counts: Every self-link occurrence and every duplicate after the first canonical target. A repeated self-link contributes to both counts; both block preflight.
metric_definitions.model_pages: Existing slug-based cohort: subjects ending in -v-arendu.

publication_note: Verify the resulting main SHA release separately; the listed successful release belongs to the package input.
